acceptance_criteria.description: Test 1 omittedQueryParamsGeneratesReturnNull_notReturnNullString (AC1,AC6): HttpComponents with queryParams=null and non-null url. Script must NOT contain "return 'null'" and MUST contain "return null".
Test 2 omittedUrlGeneratesReturnNull (AC1): all fields null. Script must NOT contain "return 'null'" and MUST contain "return null".
Test 3 allFieldsOmittedGeneratesReturnNullForAll (AC1,AC4): all four ComponentDetail fields null. Script must NOT contain "return 'null'". "return null" must appear at least 4 times.
Test 4 staticNullDataConvergesWithOmittedField (AC2,AC6): StaticComponentDetail with data==null produces same "return null" as omitted field. Neither contains "return 'null'".
Test 5 workaroundScriptPreservedUnchanged (AC2): ScriptedComponentDetail with "return [:]" is preserved verbatim in script. Script does not contain "return 'null'".
Test 6 populatedStaticMapFieldPreserved (AC3): populated headers JSON. Script contains "JsonSlurper" and the header key. No "return 'null'".
Test 7 populatedStaticStringFieldPreserved (AC3): url populated with a URL string. Script contains that URL single-quoted. No "return 'null'".
Test 8 populatedScriptedFieldPreserved (AC3): scripted url with Groovy expression. Script contains expression verbatim. No "return 'null'".
Test 9 variableAttributeComponentOmittedAttributeGeneratesReturnNull (AC4): VariableAttributeComponent with attribute=null. Script must NOT contain "return 'null'" and MUST contain "return null".
Test 10 fullHttpComponentsNoOmittedFields_noReturnNullString (AC5): all four fields fully populated. No "return 'null'". Script contains URL, JsonSlurper, and scripted expression.

Private helper methods buildStaticStringDetail, buildStaticMapDetail, buildScriptedDetail, makeHttpComponents, makeVariableAttributeComponent, and generateScript are present.
